info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Party Authentication API
info.description: The Party Authentication API facilitates secure identification and verification of users across banking channels. This endpoint allows systems to retrieve authentication status and related information for individuals or entities involved in financial transactions. Typical consumers include banking applications, financial service providers, and developers building apps requiring user authentication. The API streamlines compliance and enhances security in user interactions within digital banking environments.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve authentication details for a specific party within the cross-channel framework. You can utilize this information for managing user sessions and verifying identities across different channels.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to authenticate a party across different channels. It requires the necessary credentials and parameters for successful authentication.

200.description: The request was successful, and the authentication data has been retrieved.

GetPartyAuthenticationRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the cross-channel party authentication operation via the GET method. It is expected to be a string that could represent a request payload, such as an identifier or a token.
